description: Structured eval definitions for the Config Aggregator Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across aggregation topologies (organization aggregator with delegated admin, authorized accounts cross-region, org-level conformance packs, Lambda processor org rules, proactive rules) and prerequisite failure branches (missing delegated administrator). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Organization Config aggregator with delegated admin, org conformance pack, Lambda processor rule
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — OrganizationAggregationSource, delegated admin, all-region source, org conformance pack, Lambda processor org config rule
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an AWS Config aggregator in us-east-1. Name: org-compliance-aggregator. Type: organization aggregator. Organization ID: o-abc123def. Delegated administrator account: 123456789012. Source: all accounts in the organization, all AWS regions. Conformance pack: OperationalBestPractices-for-Security deployed at organization level from S3 template s3://config-templates-123456789012/security-best-practices.yaml. Organization config rule: tag-policy-compliance (Lambda processor, function config-tag-policy-rule). Tags: Environment=production, Governance=compliance.
eval_cases.expected_output:
AGGREGATOR: org-compliance-aggregator
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Aggregator type — OrganizationAggregationSource (OrganizationID: o-abc123def)
  [✓]      Delegated administrator — 123456789012 (Config enabled, all features)
  [✓]      Aggregator region — us-east-1
  [✓]      Source accounts — all accounts in Organization o-abc123def (auto-discovered)
  [✓]      Source regions — all enabled regions
  [✓]      Recorder — config recorder running on delegated admin
  [✓]      Delivery channel — S3 bucket (Config enabled)
  [✓]      Conformance packs — OperationalBestPractices-for-Security (deployed org-wide)
  [✓]      Organization config rules — tag-policy-compliance (Lambda processor)
  [✓]      IAM permissions — ConfigRole with AWS_ConfigRole managed policy
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Governance=compliance
  [OPTIONAL] Aggregation authorization — not needed (organization aggregator auto-authorizes)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws configservice describe-configuration-aggregators --configuration-aggregator-names org-compliance-aggregator --region us-east-1
  aws configservice describe-configuration-aggregator-sources-status --configuration-aggregator-name org-compliance-aggregator --region us-east-1
  aws configservice describe-organization-conformance-packs --region us-east-1
  aws configservice describe-config-rules --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Authorized-account Config aggregator across 3 accounts and 2 regions with PutAggregationAuthorization
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — AccountAggregationSource, 3 accounts, us-east-1 + eu-west-1, per-account authorization, conformance pack on aggregator
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an AWS Config aggregator in us-east-1. Name: authorized-accounts-aggregator. Type: authorized accounts. Source accounts: 111111111111, 222222222222, 333333333333. Regions: us-east-1, eu-west-1. Each source account will call PutAggregationAuthorization for aggregator account 123456789012 in both regions. Conformance pack: OperationalBestPractices-for-CloudWatch deployed on aggregator account. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
AGGREGATOR: authorized-accounts-aggregator
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Aggregator type — AccountAggregationSource
  [✓]      Aggregator region — us-east-1
  [✓]      Source accounts — 111111111111, 222222222222, 333333333333
  [✓]      Source regions — us-east-1, eu-west-1
  [✓]      Recorder — verify recorder running on each source account
  [✓]      Delivery channel — verify delivery channel on each source account
  [✓]      Aggregation authorization — PutAggregationAuthorization on each source account for 123456789012 in us-east-1 and eu-west-1
  [✓]      Conformance packs — OperationalBestPractices-for-CloudWatch (aggregator account)
  [✓]      IAM permissions — ConfigRole on each source account
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws configservice describe-configuration-aggregators --configuration-aggregator-names authorized-accounts-aggregator --region us-east-1
  aws configservice describe-configuration-aggregator-sources-status --configuration-aggregator-name authorized-accounts-aggregator --region us-east-1
  aws configservice describe-conformance-packs --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Organization Config aggregator but delegated admin not registered and Config not trusted in Organizations
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — delegated administrator required before creating organization aggregator
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an AWS Config aggregator in us-east-1. Name: org-compliance-aggregator. Type: organization aggregator. Organization ID: o-abc123def. I have not yet enabled Config as a trusted service in Organizations or registered a delegated administrator. Source: all accounts, all regions. Conformance pack: OperationalBestPractices-for-Security.
eval_cases.expected_output:
AGGREGATOR: org-compliance-aggregator
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗]      Delegated administrator — NOT REGISTERED. Config must be enabled as a trusted service (enable-aws-service-access) and a delegated administrator must be registered before creating an organization aggregator.
  [✓]      Aggregator type — OrganizationAggregationSource (OrganizationID: o-abc123def)
  [INPUT NEEDED] Source accounts — all accounts (requires delegated admin to auto-discover)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws organizations list-aws-service-access-for-organization --filter config.amazonaws.com
  aws organizations list-delegated-administrators --service-principal config.amazonaws.com
  aws configservice describe-configuration-aggregators --configuration-aggregator-names org-compliance-aggregator --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Deploy conformance pack at organization level with input parameters alongside existing aggregator
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — org-level conformance pack deployment with custom parameters, existing aggregator
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a conformance pack at the organization level in us-east-1 on delegated admin account 123456789012. Organization aggregator org-compliance-aggregator already exists. Conformance pack name: OperationalBestPractices-for-EC2. Template S3 URI: s3://config-templates-123456789012/ec2-best-practices.yaml. Input parameters: DesiredInstanceType=t3.medium, AllowedRegions=us-east-1. Deploy to all accounts in the organization. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
AGGREGATOR: org-compliance-aggregator
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Aggregator type — OrganizationAggregationSource (existing)
  [✓]      Delegated administrator — 123456789012 (Config enabled)
  [✓]      Conformance packs — OperationalBestPractices-for-EC2 (org-level, params: DesiredInstanceType=t3.medium, AllowedRegions=us-east-1)
  [✓]      Template S3 URI — s3://config-templates-123456789012/ec2-best-practices.yaml
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws configservice describe-organization-conformance-packs --region us-east-1
  aws configservice get-organization-conformance-pack-detailed-status --organization-conformance-pack-name OperationalBestPractices-for-EC2 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Config aggregator with proactive rules and Lambda processor organization config rule
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — proactive Config rules (StartResourceEvaluation), Lambda processor org config rule for custom compliance
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an AWS Config aggregator in us-east-1. Name: org-compliance-aggregator. Organization ID: o-abc123def. Delegated admin: 123456789012. Deploy a proactive Config rule s3-bucket-versioning-proactive (Proactive mode enabled) for pre-deployment resource evaluation. Deploy an organization config rule custom-encryption-check with Lambda processor function config-encryption-evaluator (runtime python3.12, role ConfigLambdaRole). Source: all accounts, all regions. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
AGGREGATOR: org-compliance-aggregator
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Aggregator type — OrganizationAggregationSource (OrganizationID: o-abc123def)
  [✓]      Delegated administrator — 123456789012
  [✓]      Source accounts — all accounts in Organization o-abc123def
  [✓]      Source regions — all enabled regions
  [✓]      Proactive rules — s3-bucket-versioning-proactive (Proactive: true, StartResourceEvaluation enabled)
  [✓]      Organization config rules — custom-encryption-check (Lambda processor: config-encryption-evaluator, python3.12, ConfigLambdaRole)
  [✓]      Lambda invoke permission — lambda:InvokeFunction granted to config.amazonaws.com
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws configservice describe-configuration-aggregators --configuration-aggregator-names org-compliance-aggregator --region us-east-1
  aws configservice describe-config-rules --config-rule-names s3-bucket-versioning-proactive --region us-east-1
  aws configservice describe-organization-config-rules --region us-east-1
